Rhyme instrument · v2loading lexicon
MATCH
Type a word or a phrase and press ⏎.
Rhymes come back in tiers — perfect, near, assonance, elided — with badges for what each one is doing.
The lexicon is the record. A rule widens the search, labels a result, adds a spoken count beside the lexicon count, or sounds out what the lexicon lacks. No rule removes a result or overrides a lexicon pronunciation.
